requirements.text: When the user drags a product item (li element) from the product list, the system should initiate a drag event, capturing the product's title and price for transfer. The product items are represented as 'li' elements with the attribute 'draggable' set to 'true'. Each product item contains an image, a title, and a price, identified by data-testid attributes such as 'product-item-1', 'product-title-1', and 'product-price-1'. The drag event should capture the title and price of the product being dragged.

The system should allow users to drag and drop product items(data-testid="product-item-1", data-testid="product-item-2", etc.) into a designated drop area (id="div1", data-testid="drop-area") to add them to the cart. Upon dropping, the cart display should automatically update: the product title appears in .box2, the unit price in .box3, and the quantity in .box1. The system supports adding both different and repeated products.

"The system calculates the total price by summing the prices of all products in the cart, formatting the total to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol (e.g., '$80.00'), and displays the total in the <div id="allMoney"> element."

generated_cases.title: Initiate drag event on product item
generated_cases.description: Verify that dragging a product item with draggable set to true successfully captures the title and price for transfer.

generated_cases.title: Drag product item with missing attributes
generated_cases.description: Verify the system behavior when attempting to drag an item that lacks necessary data-testid attributes for title or price.

generated_cases.title: Attempt drag on non-draggable element
generated_cases.description: Verify that elements without the draggable attribute set to true cannot trigger the product drag event.

generated_cases.title: Drop single product item into drop area updates cart display
generated_cases.description: Verify that dragging and dropping a product item (data-testid='product-item-1') into the designated drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area') successfully updates the cart display with the correct quantity in .box1, product title in .box2, and unit price in .box3.

generated_cases.title: Drop multiple different product items into drop area
generated_cases.description: Verify that dropping multiple distinct product items (e.g., 'product-item-1' and 'product-item-2') sequentially into the drop area adds all items to the cart and updates the cart display rows accordingly.

generated_cases.title: Drop repeated product items increments quantity correctly
generated_cases.description: Verify that dropping the same product item multiple times into the drop area properly handles repeated products by incrementing the quantity in .box1 rather than creating duplicate independent rows.

generated_cases.title: Calculate and Display Total Price with Standard Currency Symbol and Two Decimal Places
generated_cases.description: Verify that when products are added to the cart, the system calculates the total price correctly, formats it to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol (e.g., '$80.00'), and displays it in the <div id="allMoney"> element.

generated_cases.title: Calculate Total Price with Mixed Decimal Values
generated_cases.description: Verify that the total price calculation correctly handles items with varying decimal values, summing them accurately and displaying the correctly formatted total in <div id="allMoney">.

generated_cases.title: Calculate Total Price for Large Quantities of Repeated Items
generated_cases.description: Verify that when large quantities of repeated items are added, the system correctly aggregates the prices and displays the updated total in <div id="allMoney"> without precision errors.

generated_cases.title: Display Total Price for an Empty Cart State
generated_cases.description: Verify that when the cart is empty, the total price displayed in <div id="allMoney"> reflects a zero balance with proper formatting (e.g., '$0.00').

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Dragging a product item initiates a drag event
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Drag and Drop Product Item
  The system should initiate a drag event when a user drags a product item from the product list, capturing the product's title and price for transfer.


  Scenario: [Normal] Dragging a product item initiates a drag event
    Given the webpage is loaded with a product list
    When the user drags the product item with data-testid "product-item-1"
    Then the drag event should be initiated
    And the product title "The Essence of JavaScript" should be captured
    And the product price "$40" should be captured

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Add a single product to the cart
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Add product to cart display when dropped into the drop area
  The system should add the product to the cart display, showing the product's title, price, and quantity when a product item is dropped into the drop area.


  Scenario: [Normal] Add a single product to the cart
    Given the webpage is loaded
    And the product item with data-testid "product-item-1" is visible
    When the user drags the product with data-testid "product-item-1" and drops it into the cart container with data-testid "drop-area"
    Then the cart display should show a product with title "The Essence of JavaScript"
    And the price "$40"
    And the quantity "1"

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Add a single product to the cart and verify total price
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Calculate and display the total price of products in the cart
  The system should calculate and display the total price of all products in the cart, updating the total each time a product is added.


  Scenario: [Normal] Add a single product to the cart and verify total price
    Given the webpage is loaded with a list of products
    When the user drags the product with data-testid "product-item-1" to the drop area with data-testid "drop-area"
    Then the total price displayed in the element with id "allMoney" should be "$40.00"
